topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I can't sleep, tossing and turning all night, thinking about the fence. It’s not just a fence; it's a barrier, a wall that changes everything. The neighbor’s wn't listen, just keeps talking about privacy and property lines, but it’s deeper than that. It's the way things will never be the same, the way my kids won’t run freely from yard to yard anymore. I try to reason, to find a middle ground, but every door seems to close. What if this is just the start, what if it doesn’t end with a fence? The thought circles my mind, relentless, as I stare at the ceiling, hoping for a solution that feels increasingly out of reach.
